bio.text: Trey Kelley was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2012 and represents House District 16.
He grew up in Cedartown, graduated from Shorter University in 2008 and earned a law degree from Georgia State University College of Law in May 2014.
He is an attorney with the Parker & Lundy law firm in Cedartown and has chaired the Polk County Republican Party.
